title: FEWER RAID MESSAGES
why: his complaint 10-27: too many messages reach the player (he left the design to us). Only five kinds of line now reach the screen: danger, extraction, your teammate, money or a goal done, and the answer to something that did not work; the rest go to the run log. A search is one pickup row, the left feed takes one new line every 2.5 s, and the same warning is not drawn twice in 20 s. Measured in a staged 3 minute raid (seed 4242: looting, a fight, an extraction): 31 lines a minute before, ? after
now: fewer raid messages: only danger, extraction, your teammate, money and failed tries show; one pickup row per search (31 to ? lines a minute)
